name: Naganuma (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Naganuma town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Naganuma, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 12 September 1967.

features.role: Naganuma town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the upper fly
